exposure: Gestational weight gain (GWG) according to the Institute of Medicine (IOM) guidelines
gestational weight gain (GWG) after Institute of Medicine (IOM)
cohort: Pregnant women with type 1 or type 2 diabetes
finding: In women with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, both inadequate and excessive GWG were associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, including pregnancy-induced hypertension, cesarean delivery, and various fetal growth abnormalities.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with gestational weight gain according to IOM.
